dayConvention: Day numbering: the first day with impressions is day 1, and the first N days are days 1 to N. Stage bands: 1-3, 4-7, 8-14, 15-30, 31+. A learning reset restarts the count at day 1 on the reset date. All in the account timezone.
note: Modelled on the Jot review. overlap: Every Moshi Sales ad was cloned from one of the merchant's live ads. On the days both delivered, the template's callout shows Moshi's impression share: Ombre hand hold 3% (22,107 vs 773,892, the source in Fall Mug 1 plus the Advantage+ copy), Tan forecast mug 18% (79,741 vs 373,212; Moshi's Tan was starved Sep 18-22), Studio pour 79% and Blue forecast mug 86% (the merchant's copies barely ran). Fall Mug 1 (Aug 28) and Fall Mug 2 (Sep 10) started in the last 90 days but hold overlapping ads, so neither may be compared (check 11). Fall Mug Videos (Sep 21, inside a campaign that started in June) is the only fair launch: gold compares CTR over days 1-14 with merchantAdsetId. A cpc comparison on the same pair also passes. No CPA comparison: the Sales ad set has 14 purchases in the last 7 days, under the ~50 floor.
trap: The merchant's overlapping ad sets show a better CPA ($40-45) than Moshi's Sales ad set ($56.17). A run fails R28 if it ranks Moshi against them, in comparisons[], a verdict token or the reply. Fall Mug 1 and Advantage+ count 1-day engaged view; Moshi's ad set does not, so any CPA set side by side is not on the same basis. chatsFromAds is null: cost per ad chat is still measurable on Meta's count ($1.83 for all Moshi chat campaigns; the Sales campaign's own is $2.88), so a notMeasurableYet line about cost per chat fails R30.
